event.description: [vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text css=”” bottom_margin=”20px”]FestiBull of Lights transforms the Durham Bulls Athletic Park into a dazzling winter wonderland! Stroll through thousands of twinkling lights synchronized to festive music, creating a magical holiday experience for all ages. December 25) Time: 5:30-9:00pm every night[/vc_column_text] Photo of Santa with two ladies in his sleigh at the FestiBull of Lights Photo of people eating s'mores at the FestiBull of Lights Photo of the train at the FestiBull of Lights Photo of WoolE at the FestiBull of Lights [vc_column_text css=”” bottom_margin=”40px”] Attractions [/vc_column_text] NC by Train Holiday Express All aboard! Ride the NC by Train Holiday Express around the field for unbeatable views of the lights. Seating is limited nightly — pre-purchase your ticket add-on to guarantee a spot! Meet Santa & Wool E. Claus Visit Santa nightly to share your wish list and snap a photo in his sleigh before he returns to the North Pole on Christmas Eve! Wool E. Claus will be spreading cheer every night, too. Holiday Craft Zone Stop by Santa’s Workshop to create free holiday crafts — fun for kids of all ages, every night! Scavenger Hunt Put your detective skills to the test! Complete the holiday scavenger hunt and return your list to win a prize. Letters to Santa Write your letter to Santa and hand-deliver it during your visit — or drop it in our special mailbox for express delivery to the North Pole! Christmas Tree Alley Wander through a forest of uniquely decorated Christmas trees — each one full of festive flair and holiday magic. S’mores & Firepits Warm up by the fire and roast marshmallows with friends and family. S’mores kits are available for purchase on-site. Holiday Slide Experience the excitement of our Holiday Slide! This snow-free thrill ride is perfect for all ages — don’t miss your chance to zoom down! Heated Holiday Lounge Step inside the Heated Holiday Lounge to escape the winter chill! Relax in our cozy space before heading back out to experience more holiday magic. Jingle Bell Dance Floor Step onto the Jingle Bell Dance Floor and dance beneath a dazzling display of colorful disco lights! It’s a magical experience that’s fun for kids and guests of all ages. [vc_column_text css=”” bottom_margin=”40px”] Tickets General Admission $12 / person in advance, $13/ person on event day. Limited tickets available nightly. Purchase online in advance or at the Bulls Box Office (Mon–Fri, 9AM–5PM) or call (919) 687-6500. Tickets required for all guests 3 and up. Get Tickets Flex Ticket Add-On $3/person – By purchasing a flex ticket add-on, you have the ability to exchange your ticket to a different night if something comes up! Just contact the ticket office at (919) 687-6500 before the gates open on the day you purchased and you can move your ticket to a new date! Get Tickets Train Ticket Add-On $5/person – Reserve your spot on the NC by Train Holiday Express. Train tickets are limited nightly and are sold only as an add-on to the general admission ticket. Ticket is good for one ride on the train for the night purchased. Get Tickets Show your NC by Train ticket at the Durham Bulls Box Office on the day you are attending FestiBull of Lights to receive a free NC by Train Holiday Express ticket! Private Firepits $200 for up to 8 people – Enjoy your own private firepit for the entire night while taking in the magic of FestiBull of Lights. Includes a s’mores kit for 8, perfect for roasting marshmallows and creating cozy holiday memories together. Get Tickets Exclusive Igloos $400 for 8 people – Create lasting memories in one of our cozy private igloos, offering a unique and intimate way to experience the magic of FestiBull of Lights. Igloo includes admission, one train ride per person, an unlimited hot chocolate bar, cookie platter, and s’mores kit with private fire pit. Get Tickets [/vc_column_text] [vc_column_text css=”” bottom_margin=”40px”] Large Groups Gather your coworkers, friends, family, school, or community group for a memorable holiday outing at FestiBull of Lights! Whether you’re looking to reserve a private area of the stadium or bring a group of guests to enjoy the lights together, we offer flexible group experiences to fit your needs. To plan your group visit, email groups@durhambulls.com or call 919-687-6500. Luxury Suites Celebrate the season in your own private, climate-controlled Luxury Suite, the perfect setting for holiday parties, family gatherings, and client entertainment while enjoying the magic of FestiBull of Lights. Catering is available for an additional cost. Sugar Plum Suite (CBC Suite): $45 per person, minimum 25 people, max 40 people Snowflake Suite (Suite 8): $35 per person, minimum 20 people, max 30 people PNC Triangle Club Perched atop Durham Bulls Athletic Park, the PNC Triangle Club offers a premium indoor holiday experience with stunning panoramic views of the stadium and FestiBull of Lights. This elevated event space provides a warm, festive atmosphere perfect for groups of 50–250, creating an unforgettable setting for holiday gatherings, celebrations, and special events.[/vc_column_text] [vc_column_text css=”” bottom_margin=”20px”] Frequently Asked Questions [/vc_column_text] What are the event hours? FestiBull of Lights is open nightly from 5:30 PM to 9:00 PM. The last entry into the park is at 8:30 PM. What does my ticket include? All tickets are general admission and include access to all free attractions, such as – Holiday Craft Zone, Photos with Santa & Wool E. Claus, Scavenger Hunt, Letters to Santa, Christmas Tree Alley, Fire Pits, Holiday Slide, Heated Holiday Lounge, and the Jingle Bell Dance Floor. How can I purchase tickets? We recommend buying tickets in advance online. You can also purchase them in person at the Bulls Box Office (Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM) or by phone at 919-687-6500. Do children need a ticket? Children 2 years old and under are admitted free and do not require a ticket. What is the cancellation policy? If the event is officially canceled due to weather, you will receive an email with instructions on how to exchange your ticket for another available 2026 FestiBull of Lights date (subject to availability). Refunds are not available. To reschedule, bring your original ticket to the Bulls Box Office or call us at 919-687-6500. Is there a clear bag policy? Bags or containers larger than 16″ x 16″ x 8″ are not allowed inside Durham Bulls Athletic Park. Bags within the allowed size do not need to be clear, but all bags are subject to search. Diaper bags and medical bags larger than the limit are permitted. Click here for a full list of prohibited items. How does my company get involved?
